name: SalesOrder
description: Records a buyer's tea order, including the warehouse, selected lots, agreed quantities, sales terms, and order status.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: Date the buyer's order is recorded.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Warehouse from which eligible tea lots are selected.

fields.label: Buyer
fields.description: Buyer selected from the Party records.

fields.label: Party Rule
fields.description: Applicable party-specific rule used for this order. Preserve the applied rule reference when the order is confirmed.

fields.label: Sales Channel
fields.description: Channel through which the tea is sold.

fields.label: Order Book
fields.description: Lots included in the order, with quantity, agreed rate, and line amount.

fields.label: Total Bags
fields.description: Sum of the ordered bags across all order items.

fields.label: Total Weight (KG)
fields.description: Sum of the ordered weight across all order items.

fields.label: Order Amount
fields.description: Sum of the line amounts across all order items.

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: Payment terms copied from the applicable party rule when relevant.

fields.label: Expected Delivery Date
fields.description: Date agreed with the buyer for delivery.

fields.label: Delivery Address
fields.description: Delivery destination if it differs from the buyer's registered address.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.description: Additional order instructions or commercial terms.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Draft orders can be edited. Confirmed orders reserve stock, while cancelled orders release their reservations.
